cases.name: kokoro-scene
cases.source_text: Milo opened the smallest repair shop on the Moon. His first customer brought a telescope that could only see pebbles. Milo polished the lens and turned one tiny screw. Far above the silver hills, Earth appeared in the glass. The customer smiled. Milo hung a little bell beside his door. Tomorrow, perhaps someone would bring him a broken star.
